response.sql: WITH event_averages AS (SELECT corpeventprx, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_analyst_reports, AVG(inholdpct - instownpct) AS avg_ownership_difference FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ownership_difference) AS avg_of_event_differences FROM event_averages) SELECT e.corpeventprx, e.avg_analyst_reports, e.avg_ownership_difference, e.avg_ownership_difference - o.avg_of_event_differences AS difference_from_overall_average FROM event_averages e CROSS JOIN overall_average o WHERE o.avg_of_event_differences IS NOT NULL
